commitResults.messageBody: Fix issues found in beta testing

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix issues found in beta testing
commitResults.messageBody:
The client list can only be scrolled with the mouse, so a fast typist
has to leave the keyboard to see clients further down. This matters
most after add, edit and undo, as the client they change may be out of
view.

Some errors also do not help the user move on. The unknown command
error does not say that command words are in lower case. The unknown
prefix error does not say how to write an address such as Block A/B.
The name error writes punctuation as <->, which could be read as
allowed characters.

The app still reports v1.5, and the DG justifies the memory used by
undo with "tens of clients", which contradicts the 1,000-client NFR.

Let's scroll the client list with Shift+Page Up and Shift+Page Down,
tell users in the UG when they may need to, reword these errors and
explain the rules in the UG, set the version to v1.6, and correct the
DG.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document every keyboard shortcut in the UG and DG
commitResults.messageBody:
Mac laptops have no Page Up or Page Down keys, and the UG does not say
that Fn+Up and Fn+Down do the same job, so a tester on a MacBook may
not find how to scroll. The shortcuts are also spread across the UG,
and the DG never mentions F1 and has no manual test for F1 or Esc.

Let's list every shortcut in one UG table with its Mac laptop key, say
in the DG which class handles each one, and add the missing manual
tests.
